_notes.method: 2021-25 pbp x injury reports: team-games where the season's top-share player (WR1 tgt>=.18, RB1 car>=.35, TE1) was Out/Doubtful. pickup = (beneficiary share absent - present) / vacated share, median by role. 5-season fit replicated the 3-season numbers (RB2 .545->.567, WR2 .199->.199) and corrected a 9-sample TE1 fluke.
_notes.WR1_out_qb_note: COUNTERINTUITIVE: team QB pass yards RISE ~13% (median, n=34, 3y) when the WR1 sits; team target volume unchanged. Likely game-script confounding. Application: NO QB downgrade for a WR1 absence.
_notes.deep_roles: WR4+ medians are noisy artifacts of tiny baselines; pooled at ~0.10 in application.
_notes.TE1_out: n=15 on 5 seasons; applied at half weight.
